name: 01_sticky_note_pattern_interrupt
title: Notița Galbenă (Sticky Note Ad)
psychology: Triggers innate human curiosity. Looks non-corporate and personal, completely bypassing ad blindness.
nano_prompt: High resolution shot of a yellow sticky note stuck onto a dark oak coffee shop counter next to a cup of espresso. Clean handwriting on the note: 'Reminder: Stop paper cards! Show them QR for Apple Wallet.' Photorealistic, shallow depth of field --ar 9:16 --v 6.0
motion_prompt: Camera slowly zooms in on a yellow sticky note on a coffee shop counter, crisp lighting, cinematic 4k --ar 9:16

name: 02_iphone_notes_native_ui
title: Notițe iOS (iPhone Note App Format)
psychology: High relatability. Looks like a personal thought note written by a business owner.
nano_prompt: Clean graphic screenshot of an iOS Notes app interface on a dark background. Title in bold: '3 ways we increased coffee shop revenue by +35%:'. Bullet points: '1. Stopped paper cards. 2. Card in Apple Wallet in 2 sec. 3. Increased stamp threshold to 28 RON for extra croissant sales.' Sharp typography --ar 9:16

name: 03_us_vs_them_cognitive_contrast
title: Us vs. Them (Tabel Comparativ Vizual)
psychology: Eliminates mental effort through stark cognitive contrast between old painful way and new easy way.
nano_prompt: Split screen comparison infographic. Left side titled 'Paper Cards' with red 'X' icons showing crumpled paper cards in trash and lost customers. Right side titled 'Punctez.ro' with green checkmarks showing digital card in Apple Wallet and +10,500 RON/mo profit. Minimalist luxury theme --ar 9:16
motion_prompt: Split screen reveal animation, left side dims while right side glows with golden particles, 4k resolution --ar 9:16

name: 04_news_headline_social_proof
title: News Headline (Format Știre Locală)
psychology: Leverages media authority and social curiosity gap.
nano_prompt: News article layout with prominent headline: 'Craiova Bakery Owner Replaces Paper Cards and Increases Monthly Revenue by +35% in 30 Days'. Below headline: photo of an attractive modern bakery counter with an acrylic QR stand. Authentic journalistic style --ar 9:16
motion_prompt: Slow pan downward on a digital news article webpage, clean scroll animation --ar 9:16

name: 05_apology_scarcity_urgency
title: Apology & Scarcity Ad ('Ne Cerem Scuze')
psychology: Triggers intense FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) and loss aversion.
nano_prompt: Minimalist dark background with bold white text: 'WE APOLOGIZE TO CRAIOVA COFFEE SHOP OWNERS'. Subtitle in gold: 'Only 3 free 7-day acrylic test kits remaining for this week due to high demand.' Professional warning banner icon at the top --ar 9:16
motion_prompt: Pulsing red/gold outline border around a dark scarcity text announcement, dramatic lighting --ar 9:16

name: 06_imessage_eavesdropping_chat
title: iMessage Chat (Conversație Text Fictivă)
psychology: Plays on the human instinct to eavesdrop on private conversations.
nano_prompt: High definition iOS iMessage chat screen between 'Barista Alex' and 'Boss Costel'. Message bubble 1: 'Boss, 30 people just walked in because of the push notification on their phones!'. Message bubble 2 (blue): 'Awesome! That's another 5,000 RON in revenue this week.' Clean iOS UI --ar 9:16

name: 07_ticket_stub_sample_tactile
title: Ticket Tear-Off Stub (Bilet de Reducere Fizic)
psychology: Borrows real-world tactile sensory desire of snatching a discount ticket.
nano_prompt: Close up shot of a paper flyer with tear-off coupon tickets attached at the bottom. Each coupon ticket reads: 'FREE 7-DAY TEST KIT - QR STAND INCLUDED'. Hand reaching out to tear off a ticket, shallow depth of field --ar 9:16
motion_prompt: Hand tearing off a paper coupon ticket from a flyer on a bulletin board, slow motion 120fps --ar 9:16

name: 08_instagram_poll_question
title: Instagram Question Poll (Sondaj Interactiv)
psychology: Micro-interaction hook that forces active participation.
nano_prompt: Instagram story background featuring a blurry coffee shop interior. Center screen: native IG Question Sticker with text 'How many of your customers lose their paper punch cards?'. Poll options: 'A) Over 80%' (selected with 92% bar) vs 'B) All of them' --ar 9:16
motion_prompt: Finger tapping option A on an Instagram poll sticker, percentage bar filling up instantly --ar 9:16

name: 09_aov_financial_growth_chart
title: AOV Growth Chart (Calcul Financiar Profit)
psychology: Appeals directly to business owner greed and pragmatic ROI calculation.
nano_prompt: Sleek 3D financial bar chart graphic. Bar 1 (Red): 'Old AOV = 20 RON'. Bar 2 (Gold): 'New AOV = 28.5 RON (+35%)'. Text at top: '+10,500 RON/month extra net profit'. Dark luxury background with gold accents --ar 9:16
